Name: Revive Dead Crops
Author: atravita
Description:
This mod lets you revive dead crops. Just apply a little fairy dust. They'll still die that day, however, so be careful!

You can also use fairy dust on the stumps of fruit trees, if you accidentally cut one down.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods.
[/list]
